title: fjord verify --json
description: Output of `fjord verify --json`. This shape is published API: fields may be added, but an existing field's name, type and meaning will not change. Diagnostic codes are likewise stable — see README § Diagnostics.

tool.description: Name and version of the tool that produced this report.

formatVersion.description: The `fjord` version the repository declares. Null when absent or not an integer, which is itself reported as a diagnostic.

conforms.description: True when no error-severity diagnostic was found. Warnings do not affect it.

readOnly.description: True when the repository declares a format version newer than this build implements. Writing to it is forbidden (spec §10.1).

vaults.description: Vaults discovered on the filesystem, which is authoritative (spec §2.1). A vault whose manifest could not be parsed is absent from this list and present in `diagnostics`.

name.description: The vault's label, which need not match its directory.

fileNaming.description: "plain" or "id". Any other value is reported as E110 and passed through here as written.

recipients.description: Recipients that parsed as usable keys. Zero on a plaintext vault.

files.description: Every other file, vault machinery excluded.

path.description: Repository-relative path, or null for a repository-wide finding.

detail.description: Extra context for this occurrence: the field at fault, a parser message, a line number.
